_how_to_add: To show a photo instead of a drawing: upload the image to public/minds/ (for example public/minds/einstein.jpg), then add an entry here keyed by the person's slug, such as "einstein": { "file": "einstein.jpg", "credit": "Photographer, year. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons" }. Use only photos whose licence allows reuse, and give the credit the licence asks for. Slugs are listed in src/data/minds.js and src/data/minds-more.json.
